issues.issue: Was the officer's refusal under IRPR 200(3)(f.1), for no new LMIA-exempt number and fee, reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: not stated; the text says he does not dispute the facts, and the refusal wrongly cited invalid biometrics.
issues.respondent_position: The biometrics error was not determinative; the refusal rests on the unmet R200(3)(f.1) requirements.
issues.result_quote: The decision is reasonable. It is responsive to the evidence before the Officer and complies with the requirements of the program to which the Applicant had applied.

issues.issue: Did the officer breach procedural fairness by not warning him about the missing LMIA number and unpaid fee?
issues.applicant_position: The officer should have notified him or the employer of concerns about the LMIA number and unpaid fees.
issues.result_quote: There is no breach of procedural fairness when an officer refuses an application simply because the evidence provided does not meet statutory requirements.
